seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A mariachi drifter named Bunny is on the run from a ruthless headhunter named Lalo. What begins as a high speed chase along desert highways and speeding freight-trains, balloons into an odyssey of mythic proportions. Bunny is a modern day Orpheus, with a broken heart and an ability to charm living things with music. As Bunny runs deeper into the desert, fragments of the past materialise. Bunny and Lalo were once prospecting partners. When they struck opal, Bunny betrayed Lalo for a girl named Lucy, stealing the opal and leaving Lalo for dead. But opals can't buy love. Ultimately Lucy betrays Bunny too. And so, Bunny's grueling journey takes on a new dimension, that of atonement. When Bunny reaches an inland salt lake, he stops running. At the end of the earth and stripped of everything, he's finally ready to face Lalo in an explosive finale. Each episode features an original song by 'Cowboy Malfoy'.

title: Killing Bunny
